status: not publicly available as a clean bulk dataset
dataset: Mumbai emergency/flood shelters (name, address, lat/lon, capacity, type)
sources_checked: MCGM/BMC Disaster Management Department pages - lists some designated flood-relief shelter buildings (typically municipal schools) in monsoon advisories, but as PDF/news notices, not a structured downloadable dataset
data.gov.in - no dedicated Mumbai shelters layer found
OpenStreetMap (amenity=shelter, social_facility=shelter tags) - sparse/inconsistent coverage for Mumbai specifically
NDMA (National Disaster Management Authority) portals - general guidance, no Mumbai-specific shelter GIS layer found
missing_data: A structured list of designated Mumbai flood/emergency shelters with coordinates and capacity
possible_fallback: MCGM municipal school buildings (frequently used as ad-hoc flood shelters) could be approximated via OSM amenity=school within flood-prone wards, but this is an ASSUMPTION, not an official shelter designation - must be clearly labeled as such if used.
notes: Per task instructions: addresses without coordinates should not have invented lat/lon. No qualifying dataset was found to populate 10_shelters/shelters.geojson without either fabricating data or making an unlabeled assumption, so this file is intentionally left undownloaded.
